title: The cellTower Pattern — Sovereign Identity Mesh
principle: Every gate is a cell tower. Devices roam. The pocketBook holds your identity. bingoCube coordinates the handoff. The organism IS the network.

bingoCube.ceremony: HOLD → SEE → SEAL (proximity sign via bingoCube face)

cellTowers.description: Each gate is a cell tower. Devices roam. The mesh tracks by signal strength.

pattern.tower: A gate with compute + storage + relay capability
pattern.device: A roaming pseudopod (Pixel, Deck, Frame, laptop)
pattern.handoff: As device moves between towers, nearest tower serves it
pattern.triangulation: WiFi RSSI from multiple towers → position estimate
pattern.coverage: Each tower has a radius: WiFi range + wired backbone

jetStream.note: Not a tower — the SPINE between towers

grapheneGate.triangulation: WiFi RSSI + GPS + cell tower CID
grapheneGate.note: PRIMARY ROAMER — Pixel is Kevin's phone, goes where he goes

deckGate.note: Permanent display — .176 wired + .203 WiFi, also showing /organism

frameGate.note: TRUE HEART AND EYE — SteamVR passthrough AR, Gaia sees the world through this

southGate.note: iPhone XS — pinned to property but can roam

handoff_protocol.trigger: RSSI delta > 10dB between towers, or tower goes dark
steps: 1. Device senses RSSI from all visible towers (WiFi APs)
2. bingoCube state transitions: current tower → SENSE → new tower
3. RustDesk LAN discovery auto-routes to nearest relay
4. pocketBook identity travels WITH the device (not stored on tower)
5. New tower picks up data flow seamlessly

ears.voice: GL-MT6000 Router — broadcasts on all bands

handoff_protocol.triangulation: Compare L/R ear RSSI. Stronger left = House 1. Stronger right = House 2. Both = property line.

unification.description: pocketBook + bingoCube + cellTower = ONE sovereign mesh
unification.formula: IDENTITY = pocketBook(who) × bingoCube(where in social space) × cellTower(where in physical space)
unification.no_provider: No carrier. No cloud. No SIM card needed. The organism IS the network.
unification.sovereignty: Kevin + Gaia carry the pocketBook. Towers don't own it. Towers SERVE it.
unification.roaming: As Kevin walks from House 1 to House 2, the Pixel hands off between towers. His pocketBook goes with him. bingoCube state persists across handoffs.
unification.disaster_mode: If all towers go dark, the pocketBook still works — two phones in range can mesh directly via Bluetooth/WiFi Direct. AMOEBA needs no infrastructure.
